name: Maintenance: Rebuild Caches & Search Index
description: Server-side maintenance workflow. Step 1 (clear-caches) flushes the in-memory cache service used by the wiki API responses (search, suggestions, navigation, spaces) and invalidates the per-space folder tree cache, forcing clients to refetch on their next request. Step 2 (rebuild-search) force-rebuilds the full-text search index from disk (skipping the on-disk index cache) and reports the resulting index statistics. Runs in-process against the live backend via the shared service registry and globals, so no auth token or base URL is required. Safe to run any time; the search rebuild runs to completion before the step reports success.
